samples.summary: `cascadeMasterStyles` reads the master's placeholder typography straight off the live CRDT, bypassing the new `bandMasterNumerics` guard, and commits the poisoned value into real blocks
samples.evidence: The change bands masters at the two readers it found — `read()` (`yorkie-slides-store.ts:485`) and `resolveMasterAndTheme()` (`:1322`), the latter with the explicit rationale "this is the reader that actually feeds `seedPlaceholderBlocks`: without it a poisoned master's `fontSize` is *committed* to the CRDT". But `updateMaster()` passes the **live, unbanded** master object (`yorkie-slides-store.ts:1082` `(r as { masters?: Master[] }).masters?.find(...)`) into `cascadeMasterStyles`, which at `:1144-1147` does `const style = yorkieToPlain<PlaceholderStyle>((master.placeholderStyles as Record<string, unknown>)[t]); if (style) data.blocks = clone(seedPlaceholderBlocks(style, theme));`. So any user who touches master typography on a deck whose `masters` a peer poisoned writes `fontSize: 1e9` / `lineHeight: 1e9` into every empty placeholder's stored `data.blocks` — exactly the outcome the `resolveMasterAndTheme` band and the new `keeps a poisoned master out of the blocks a layout change seeds` test exist to prevent. Fix belongs on the new code: band `master` (or `style`) before the seed at line 1147.

samples.summary: `resolveLayout()` returns a layout unbanded, so `addSlide` / `applyLayout` copy a peer-poisoned layout placeholder body into a real slide element — the write-side twin of the `read()` layout band the diff added
samples.evidence: `read()` now bands layouts (`yorkie-slides-store.ts:470-472`) with the stated reason that placeholder specs carry the same codec-free `data.blocks` and "`seedPlaceholderBlocks` copies their typography into the real blocks a layout change materializes". The path that actually materializes them does not use `read()`: `resolveLayout()` (`:1344-1350`) does a bare `yorkieToPlain<Layout[]>(root.layouts)` with no `bandLayoutNumerics`, and its result feeds `addSlide` (`:746`, which clones `placeholder.data` verbatim for every non-text placeholder at `:782-786`, and falls back to `placeholderData.blocks` at `:768`) and `applyLayout` (`:1288` → `applyLayoutToSlide`, which pushes `clone(slot.spec)` wholesale at `packages/slides/src/model/layout.ts:434,456-461` — only a *text* slot's `blocks` are replaced by the seed, so a poisoned `shape` placeholder's `data.text.blocks` rides through). The poisoned numerics are then committed to the Yorkie root for every viewer. Fix belongs on the new code: wrap `resolveLayout`'s result in `bandLayoutNumerics`.

samples.summary: `MemSlidesStore.cascadeMasterStyles` / `addSlide` seed placeholder blocks from an unbanded master, so the `bandMasterNumerics` guard has no effect on the in-memory store
samples.evidence: `packages/slides/src/store/memory.ts:377-378` (`const style = master.placeholderStyles[t]; if (style) el.data.blocks = seedPlaceholderBlocks(style, theme);`) and `:210` read `this.doc` masters directly. `MemSlidesStore` is the store the revision preview mounts (`packages/frontend/src/components/history/revision-preview.tsx:582`) and the harness uses; the preview's input is banded by the new `bandSlidesDocumentNumerics`, so this is mostly latent today, but any other construction of a `MemSlidesStore` from untrusted JSON (e.g. `packages/frontend/src/app/documents/miro-import-composition.test.ts:92`, harness `page.tsx:377`) reaches `seedPlaceholderBlocks` with an unbanded `PlaceholderStyle`.

samples.summary: The new wrong-typed-value 400s (`style.fontSize`, master `fontSize`/`lineHeight`) break GET → PUT for decks that already store such a value, because the GET path returns the stored body verbatim
samples.evidence: `readSlidesRoot` (`packages/backend/src/yorkie/slides-tree.ts:52-81`) is a plain `unwrapJson` of the root — it applies no band and no coercion, and `getContent` returns it directly (`docs-content.controller.ts:156-158`). Before this change `assertValidSlidesBody` never inspected `masters` at all and never type-checked `inline.style.fontSize`, so a `PUT` carrying `{"fontSize": "24"}` (or a master `placeholderStyles.body.fontSize: "44"`) was accepted and stored. The new `normalizeSlideInlines` throw and `bandMasterPlaceholderStyles` throw now reject exactly those bodies, so a `GET` → unmodified `PUT` of such a deck (the CLI content round-trip, `document-copy`-style flows) 400s. The diff's own comment claims "a `GET` → edit → `PUT` cannot be 400ed by it" — that holds for the frontend reader (which deletes a non-number), not for the v1 GET, which echoes the stored string. Note the PPTX-export comment at `packages/slides/src/export/pptx/text.ts:95` asserts that exactly this shape (`"listLevel": "2"`) is reachable through the endpoint today.

samples.summary: `font-catalog.ts` now imports `@wafflebase/docs` at module scope, pulling the docs barrel into every chunk that touches the shared font UI
samples.evidence: `font-catalog.ts` is imported by slides (`packages/frontend/src/app/slides/pdf-actions.ts:3`, `slides-view.tsx:36`, `theme-builder-panel.tsx:27`) and docs views; the new `import { MAX_FONT_SIZE } from '@wafflebase/docs'` (`font-catalog.ts:18`) makes those chunks depend on the docs package barrel for a single numeric constant. The per-chunk bundle budget lane would surface it if it matters; flagged only because the dependency direction is new.

verdict.reason: The code is present exactly as described. `updateMaster` (yorkie-slides-store.ts:1082) resolves the live, unbanded CRDT master proxy and passes it to `cascadeMasterStyles` (:1111-1115), which at :1144-1147 reads `master.placeholderStyles[t]` straight off the CRDT and commits `seedPlaceholderBlocks(style, theme)` into `data.blocks`. `seedPlaceholderBlocks` (packages/slides/src/model/placeholder-blocks.ts:30,38) copies `fontSize`/`lineHeight` verbatim and bands nothing, so the new `bandMasterNumerics` guard (packages/slides/src/model/band-numerics.ts:130-146) — applied at the two readers :485-487 and :1322-1324, the latter explicitly to stop a poisoned master being *committed* — is bypassed on this write path. The path is reachable from ordinary UI typography edits (theme-builder-panel.tsx:113,121; theme-panel-helpers.ts:46). No guard elsewhere sanitises the proxy inside `withUpdate`. In-lane for blast-radius (new guard with an unguarded second entry point) and blocking at major severity: poisoned numerics are persisted to the shared document for all peers.

verdict.reason: Verified in-repo. `read()` bands layouts at yorkie-slides-store.ts:470-472 with the stated rationale that placeholder specs carry codec-free `data.blocks` seeded into real elements. The write-side resolver `resolveLayout()` (:1344-1350) does a bare `yorkieToPlain<Layout[]>(root.layouts)` with no `bandLayoutNumerics` — grep confirms line 471 is the only call in the file. Its result feeds `addSlide` (:746), which for non-text placeholders copies `data: placeholder.data` verbatim (:782-788) and for text placeholders falls back to unbanded `placeholderData.blocks` when no placeholderStyle resolves (:766-768), and `applyLayout` (:1288 → :1296) → `applyLayoutToSlide`, which pushes `clone(slot.spec)` wholesale (packages/slides/src/model/layout.ts:434,456-461) and only replaces a *text* slot's `blocks`, so a `shape` placeholder's `data.text.blocks` (a shape body bandElementNumerics explicitly covers, band-numerics.ts:65-71) rides through unbanded and is committed to the shared Yorkie root. The file's own sibling write-side resolver `resolveMasterAndTheme` bands masters at :1318-1324 with the explicit reasoning that a read-side band 'would only hide it from this client' — layouts are the untreated twin. Layouts are peer-writable (updateLayout :1152, updateLayoutPlaceholderFrame :1167). I considered `already-guarded` via read()'s element bands (:531,539,558) but those only mask the poison for readers going through read(); they do not prevent the commit, which the repo's own comment treats as the harm. In lane: a new guard with another entry point reaching the protected operation.

verdict.reason: Verified in-repo. The v1 GET for slides returns the stored root verbatim: readSlidesRoot (packages/backend/src/yorkie/slides-tree.ts:52-81) is only unwrapJson per field with meta defaulting, getContent returns it unchanged (docs-content.controller.ts:156-160), and no band/normalizer from @wafflebase/slides is imported anywhere in packages/backend. The PUT arm now throws 400 for a non-number inline style.fontSize (docs-content.controller.ts:1298-1306) and for a non-number master placeholderStyles fontSize/lineHeight (docs-content.controller.ts:620-627); both behaviours are locked in by tests (docs-content.validation.spec.ts:190-194, 231-243), and they are deliberately stricter than the sibling image-size handling which merely drops wrong-typed values (validation.spec.ts:153-157). The in-code rationale that readers already band such values (controller comment at 1288-1296) is true only of the frontend path — packages/slides/src/model/band-numerics.ts:48-50,130-146 coerces with asFiniteNumber and falls back to DEFAULT_MASTER — not of the v1 GET, which echoes the stored string. That stored wrong-typed typography is a real population is asserted by the repo itself: packages/slides/src/export/pptx/text.ts:61-99 documents that slide text bodies are persisted verbatim through the content PUT API and that a string listLevel "is stored as the string it was sent as". Consequently a CLI `slides get-content` -> unmodified `slides set-content` round-trip (packages/cli/src/client/http-client.ts:507-518, packages/cli/src/commands/slides.ts:178,228, packages/cli/src/commands/content-write.ts:67) of such a deck now fails with a 400 the caller cannot fix without editing content they did not author. That is a consumer outside the diff broken by a stricter contract — squarely this lens's lane — and none of not-present / already-guarded / out-of-scope / counterexample applies.

finding.summary: `master.placeholderStyles.{fontSize,lineHeight}` is a peer-writable numeric that reaches the exact sink the new bands guard, and it is read unbanded — the change bands slides/elements/notes/layouts but skips `masters`.
finding.evidence: `read()` does `const masters = yorkieToPlain<Master[]>(rootAny.masters);` (packages/frontend/src/app/slides/yorkie-slides-store.ts:465) with no band, while the two lines above it deliberately band `layouts` via `bandLayoutNumerics` and the slide walk bands every element. `Master.placeholderStyles` carries `fontSize` and `lineHeight` (packages/slides/src/model/master.ts:4-34), and those values are copied *verbatim into a docs `Block`* by `seedPlaceholderBlocks` — `inlines[0].style.fontSize = style.fontSize` and `style.lineHeight = style.lineHeight` (packages/slides/src/model/placeholder-blocks.ts:30,38) — which is precisely the `fontSize`/`lineHeight` pair `bandBlockNumerics`/`normalizeFontSize`/`normalizeLineHeight` were added to bound. The same value is also multiplied straight into a canvas font at packages/slides/src/view/canvas/text-renderer.ts:362 (`ctx.font = `${style.fontSize * fontScale}px ...``) and read by packages/slides/src/model/layout.ts:444 and packages/slides/src/view/canvas/layout-preview.ts:38. The board twin has the same gap. So one peer writing `masters[0].placeholderStyles.body.fontSize = 1e9` bypasses every band this change adds. The write side agrees it is unguarded and says so on the wrong premise: packages/backend/src/api/v1/docs-content.controller.ts:567-569 states "`masters` needs no walk … it carries no elements and no `Block`s, so there is nothing of this shape inside it" — true of `Block`s, false of the numerics that become one. Fix belongs on the new code (band `masters` on read, and/or walk `placeholderStyles` in `assertValidSlidesBody`).

verdict.reason: The described unbanded code does not exist. `YorkieSlidesStore.read()` bands masters explicitly: `const masters = yorkieToPlain<Master[]>(rootAny.masters)?.map((m) => bandMasterNumerics(m));` (packages/frontend/src/app/slides/yorkie-slides-store.ts:485-487, import at :42), not the bare `yorkieToPlain` the finding quotes. The seeding-path reader that actually feeds `seedPlaceholderBlocks` bands too (same file :1318-1324). `bandMasterNumerics` (packages/slides/src/model/band-numerics.ts:130-146) walks `placeholderStyles` by every key and applies `normalizeFontSize`/`normalizeLineHeight` with DEFAULT_MASTER fallbacks; `bandSlidesDocumentNumerics` bands `masters` for the snapshot-adapter readers (band-numerics.ts:172-174, consumed at packages/frontend/src/components/history/snapshot-adapters.ts:53,75). The write side also contradicts the quoted comment: packages/backend/src/api/v1/docs-content.controller.ts:578-589 states masters carry "the numerics that *become* one" and calls `bandMasterPlaceholderStyles` for each master. The alleged board twin gap is absent as well — board synthesizes `masters: [DEFAULT_MASTER]` (packages/board/src/model/board.ts:44,69), so no peer-writable master exists there.

finding.summary: `deckFontScale(meta.pxPerPt)` multiplies every banded slide font size at paint time with no ceiling, so a peer-written `meta.pxPerPt` defeats `MAX_FONT_SIZE` entirely.
finding.evidence: `deckFontScale` rejects non-finite and non-positive `pxPerPt` but has no upper bound: `return meta.pxPerPt / DOCS_PX_PER_PT;` (packages/slides/src/model/presentation.ts:139-144). It is applied to every text element, shape text, table and chart on the slide — packages/slides/src/view/canvas/element-renderer.ts:252 then 273/283/318/328/356/365 — and directly to the placeholder hint at packages/slides/src/view/canvas/text-renderer.ts:362. `meta` is peer-writable on the Yorkie root and is read through `migrateMeta` (packages/frontend/src/app/slides/yorkie-slides-store.ts:481) with no band; the backend `assertValidSlidesBody` only checks the minimal meta shape (packages/backend/src/api/v1/docs-content.controller.ts:524-549). A `pxPerPt` of 1e9 turns a legitimately-banded 11 pt run into an ~8e9 px line, which is the same blank/huge-allocation render the new bands exist to prevent, reached by a field the change never touches.

verdict.reason: The finding claims `deckFontScale` has no upper bound and returns `meta.pxPerPt / DOCS_PX_PER_PT` unclamped. In this repository the function returns `Math.min(MAX_DECK_FONT_SCALE, meta.pxPerPt / DOCS_PX_PER_PT)` with `MAX_DECK_FONT_SCALE = 20` (packages/slides/src/model/presentation.ts:150, 170-175), so the quoted evidence line does not exist. The clamp is the single chokepoint for every consumer named in the finding: `DOCS_PX_PER_PT` is referenced nowhere outside presentation.ts and one test, so element-renderer.ts:252, text-renderer.ts and editor.ts all take their `fontScale` from `deckFontScale(doc.meta)` and inherit the bound; no path divides `pxPerPt` itself. The finding's concrete scenario (`pxPerPt: 1e9` -> ~8e9 px line) yields 20 instead, and is covered by an explicit test at packages/slides/test/model/presentation.test.ts:37-53. Ground: not-present.
